introduce:
Lay prone on the ground with arms supporting your body. 

Keep your body straight while raising and lowering your body with your arms. 

This exercise works the chest, shoulders, triceps, back and legs.
name: PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your wrists directly under your shoulders.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, elevate your feet on a bench.
To make it more challenging, clap your hands when pushing up.
Too hard for you? You can elevate your hands on a bench.
If you feel it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
To make it easier, do it with your hands against a wall.
This exercise really works on your chest, abs and triceps.
This exercise helps build your strength and endurance.
Adjust your performance if you feel strain in your shoulders.

introduce:
Start in the regular push-up position but with your hands elevated on a chair or bench. 

Then push your body up down using your arm strength. 

Remember to keep your body straight.
name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair or bench.
Your body needs to be kept straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
You shouldn't put too much pressure on your shoulders.
Do not raise or lower your hips.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
Too easy for you? Put your feet on the bench instead of your hands.
You shouldn't feel pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise primarily works on your chest.

introduce: Run in place while pulling your knees as high as possible with each step. \n\nKeep your upper body upright during this exercise.
name: HIGH STEPPING

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Do it as fast as you can.
Don't bend your back.
Breathe naturally.
To make it harder, raise your knees as high as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, slow down.
You can feel your heartbeat quickening.
This is a great exercise for your lower body.
This cardio exercise can strengthen your heart and lungs.

introduce: Start in the regular push-up position, then let your knees touch the floor and raise your feet up off the floor. \n\nNext push your body up and down.
name: KNEE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: You need to do it on a mat.
Your body should be straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't rotate your shoulders towards your chest.
Don't drop or raise your head.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it more difficult, perform a traditional push-up.
Your should not feel too much pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise targets all the major muscle groups of your upper body.

introduce:
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and arms stretched forward. Take a big step forward and lower your body until your front knee is at a 90 degree angle. 

Then twist your upper body to the same side as your front leg and twist back. Go back to the start position and switch to the other leg. 

Your upper body should always be kept straight. Keep your knees facing forward as you twist.

It's a great exercise for the quads, gluteus and hamstrings.
name: LUNGE TWIST

tips.text: Your knees should always face forward.
Keep your upper body straight.
Your front knee should be at a 90 degree angle.
Don't twist your hips.
If it's too easy for you, hold weight in your hands.
Inhale as you lower into the lunge, and exhale as you twist your upper body.
Inhale as you return to center, and exhale as you stand back up.
This exercise can strengthen your legs and core.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended to your sides at the shoulder height. 

Then bend your body and use your left hand to touch your right foot or get as close as you can. Switch sides and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. 

Keep your back and legs straight during the exercise.
name: CROSS TOUCH AND REACH

tips.text: Keep your back straight when bending your body.
Bend your body at 90 degrees.
Don't bend your knees.
Exhale as you bend down, and inhale as you come up.
When your arm is up in the air, you should feel stretch from your fingers to toes.
This exercise helps you warm up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings, torso and arms.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce: Place one arm across your body, parallel to the ground, then use the other arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. \n\nHold for a while, switch arms and repeat the exercise. Keep the inside arm straight during the exercise.
name: SHOULDER STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. 

Hold a dumbbell in each hand, and raise your arms towards the ceiling with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent. 

Lower the dumbbells out to the sides until your upper arms touch the floor. Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DUMBBELL CHEST FLY

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells.
Please do this on a mat.
Please always keep your back flat on the floor.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
You should feel your chest engaged.
This exercise works your chest muscles.

introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your hands against the wall. Slowly step back and slide your hands down until your upper body is parallel to the floor. \n\nPush your hands forward into the wall as you pull your hips away from the wall. Transfer your weight into your feet. Hold this position.
name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG ON THE WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please put your feet under your hips to feel more stretch.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This exercise can elongate your spine and stretch your shoulders and legs.

introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your legs and arms straight. \n\nKick your left leg up to touch your right hand to your toes. Repeat with the other side.
name: TOY SOLDIERS

tips.text: Keep your back and legs straight.
Tighten your abs.
Don't lean your upper body forward.
Exhale as you raise your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise targets the hamstrings and hip flexors.
